entities.summary: Slovenian Spring, a transformative movement in Slovenia (1980–1991). Emerged from Socialist Modernisation & Economic Leadership. Catalyzed Slovenian independence plebiscite – 88.5% vote yes and Slovenia declares independence; Ten-Day War begins.
